notes.title: Stig & BOND - Colorful Cube Conundrums
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882035/8336ae503c0ddd4d837d9322c35dae5f2a84465e.png[/img]

[h3]Super excited about our first Steam bundle! [/h3]
The "Stig & BOND - Colorful Cube Conundrums" bundle is out now 🙌

BOND is a 3D sokoban game by Gustav Almström. We really enjoyed playing it, so we reached out to Gustav and he agreed to team up! 🤝

[h3]Check out the bundle:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50447/Stig__BOND__Colorful_Cube_Conundrums/

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
We've made two small adjustments to Stig:
[list]
[*] Skipping a level no longer marks that level as completed. You can continue forward, but your game progress will not be affected, and no achievements will be gained.
[*] There is now an animation playing if you attempt to push something that cannot be moved.
[/list]

Wishing you happy holidays!
Miriam & Lage

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
The first update to Stig is here! We have fixed various small issues and bugs, and added two new features to the game:

[list]
[*] Stuck? There's now a possibility to skip levels from the pause menu
[*] Do you want to start over? There are now multiple save profiles and a reset progress button
[/list]

notes.title: Stig is out now!
notes.notes:
The full release of Stig is here! 🎉
We've been working on this game for the past year, and we are super excited to share it with you.

Can you solve your way all the way to the end? 🧩
